title: Ramadan break revision set: English Language
subject: English Language
source: Written for english-language/y11 lesson 39 (Ramadan break revision set (Section A, B and C tasks) (pupil PDF))
intro: Choose the tasks that match your repair list. Use Text One 'The Last Ferry' and Text Two 'Advice to Those Who Travel by Sea' from your lessons.

questions.q: In 'The Last Ferry', how does the writer use language to show the sea? (10 marks: 15 minutes)
questions.a: Similes ('like something breathing in its sleep'), personification ('as if the sea were weighing us'), the short sentence 'Nobody spoke.', the contrast of the safe kitchen; analysis of effects.

questions.q: In 'Advice to Those Who Travel by Sea', how does the writer use structure to present his advice? (10 marks: 15 minutes)
questions.a: Opening general warning; practical advice in the middle; 'Above all' for the key lesson; the final metaphor of the sea as 'a stern schoolmaster'.

questions.q: Compare how the two writers present their ideas and perspectives about travelling by sea. (15 marks: 20 minutes)
questions.a: Personal memoir against general advice; fear and gratitude against calm authority; both see the sea as powerful and a teacher of patience.

questions.q: Write a guide for students going on a school trip by boat, using ideas from both texts in your own words. (30 marks: 45 minutes)
questions.a: Adapted ideas from both texts; guide form for students; accurate writing.

questions.q: (a) 'Patience is the most useful thing anyone can learn.' Discuss. (b) Write a story called 'The Crossing'. (c) Describe a harbour in winter. (30 marks: 45 minutes)
questions.a: AO4 20: crafted response suited to the task; AO5 10: accuracy and range.
